event: Nala: "Go down to the village. There should be more chambers from the wolves I killed there."
Nala: "Bring back any you can find. I'll focus on clearing the water, and we'll see if it helps."
Hawise nods once and is gone over the rim, blurring down the goat track.
Nala kneels at the pool's edge and reaches into the shallows with her tide.
Cupful by cupful she parts the black from the water. At first each takes minutes.
After an hour she has the rhythm: a cupful in about a minute. Faster, and the black slips back.

memory.fact: With fine work Undertow can part the black from the water: a cupful takes Nala a few minutes.
With fine work Undertow can part the black from the water: a cupful takes Nala a few minutes.

event: The beads run together into one, and a single thread of her tide holds it all.
She reaches out for the pool's middle, where the swells start. It lies beyond her reach.

memory.fact: Nala drained three greymaws dead in the lane at Marsh Croft at dusk on day one.

event: The black is thickest out there. It thins toward the shore where she kneels.
By mid-afternoon a patch of shore water a few paces wide lies clear before her.
Then a swell rolls in from the middle. Fresh black clouds the clear patch.
Within the hour it's as dark as the rest.
The longer she works, the nearer the stair dream feels, like a sound just past hearing.

memory.fact: To Nala's well, the black Water feels like the water of her stair dream.
To Nala's well, the black Water feels like the water of her stair dream.

event: After three hours her focus frays, as it did after the flurry against Hawise.

changes.note: Three hours parting the black from the pool's shallows, cupful by cupful

memory.fact: Pushes timed with spearwork in a flurry wear Nala's mind fast, like fine work, not plain towing.

event: She presses the gathered black into the chamber. It fills a fair part of it.

changes.note: Her well comes back full over the afternoon's work

make.title: Greymaw Chamber of Sea-Water
make.description: A fist-sized knot of polished grey bone, ice-cold, a fair part filled with black Sea-Water. It tugs faintly toward the pool it came from.

changes.note: A whole chamber pressed full of the parted black Sea-Water

memory.fact: A whole greymaw chamber holds raw Sea-Water fast; nothing seeps back out.
A whole greymaw chamber holds raw Sea-Water fast; nothing seeps back out.

event: Late in the day Hawise comes back over the rim, breathing hard, a sack on her shoulder.
Hawise: "Dray had five, in a crate. Kept them for you."

make.title: Cracked Greymaw Chamber
make.description: A fist-sized knot of polished grey bone, layered like a shell, cracked clean through by a spear.

changes.note: Five cracked chambers Dray kept for Nala, brought up by Hawise

memory.fact: Dray's men carted the last five greymaws down; their chambers sit in a crate in Dray's storeroom.
Dray's men carted the last five greymaws down; their chambers sit in a crate in Dray's storeroom.
Dray keeps the five chambers for Nala, and hands them to a Keep rider who asks in her name.
Dray keeps the five chambers for Nala, and hands them to a Keep rider who asks in her name.

event: She tips them out on the rock. Five grey knots of bone, each cracked clean through.

memory.fact: All five greymaws Nala speared in the den and by the tarn have chambers cracked through.
All five greymaws Nala speared in the den and by the tarn have chambers cracked through.

event: The sun sits low on the Whitecombs. The pool swells, and eases, and swells.
Hawise: "And a Senior Keeper rode into the Ford today. Maud Ashby. Asking after you."

memory.fact: Senior Keeper Maud Ashby rode into Wendle Ford on day twenty-eight, asking after Nala.
